 <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#d8c6b2">
<meta name="description" content="Invitación de cumpleaños de Araceli — 60 años">
<title>Araceli | 60 años</title>

<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Montserrat:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap');

:root {
  --cream:#f8f3ec;
  --ivory:#fffdf9;
  --blue:#9eb9c3;
  --blue-dark:#587783;
  --gold:#b9955b;
  --gold-light:#dbc28f;
  --rose:#d7a3a1;
  --ink:#3f4748;
  --white:#fff;
  --shadow:0 25px 70px rgba(63,71,72,.14);
}

*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  margin:0;
  color:var(--ink);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 15% 10%, rgba(215,163,161,.12), transparent 25%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 90% 20%, rgba(158,185,195,.16), transparent 28%),
    var(--cream);
  font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
button,a{font:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer}

.envelope-screen{
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:999;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(255,255,255,.92), rgba(248,243,236,.98)),
    var(--cream);
  transition:opacity 1s ease, visibility 1s ease;
}
.envelope-screen::before,
.envelope-screen::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  border-radius:50%;
  border:1px solid rgba(185,149,91,.22);
}
.envelope-screen::before{width:70vw;height:70vw}
.envelope-screen::after{width:52vw;height:52vw}

.opening{
  position:relative;
  z-index:2;
  width:min(92vw,560px);
  text-align:center;
}
.opening-kicker{
  font-size:11px;
  letter-spacing:5px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold);
}
.opening h1{
  margin:12px 0 4px;
  font:600 clamp(42px,9vw,76px)/.9 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  color:var(--blue-dark);
}
.opening p{
  margin:12px 0 34px;
  font:400 22px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  color:#6b6966;
}
.envelope-wrap{display:flex;justify-content:center}
.envelope{
  position:relative;
  width:min(82vw,360px);
  height:245px;
  perspective:1100px;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 24px 28px rgba(72,72,72,.2));
}
.env-body{
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  border-radius:8px;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#dce9eb,#a9c3cb);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.env-body::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(35deg,transparent 49%,rgba(255,255,255,.45) 50%,transparent 51%),
    linear-gradient(-35deg,transparent 49%,rgba(255,255,255,.35) 50%,transparent 51%);
}
.flap{
  position:absolute;
  z-index:5;
  top:0;left:0;
  width:0;height:0;
  border-left:calc(min(82vw,360px)/2) solid transparent;
  border-right:calc(min(82vw,360px)/2) solid transparent;
  border-top:132px solid #bdd0d5;
  transform-origin:top center;
  transition:transform 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1);
}
.front{
  position:absolute;
  z-index:6;
  left:0;right:0;bottom:0;
  height:150px;
  clip-path:polygon(0 0,50% 54%,100% 0,100% 100%,0 100%);
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,#a8c2c9,#91aeb8);
}
.front::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(150deg,transparent 48%,rgba(255,255,255,.18) 49%,transparent 50%);
}
.seal{
  position:absolute;
  z-index:10;
  left:50%;top:52%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  width:78px;height:78px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,#d8bd84,#a98145);
  color:#fffdf9;
  border:5px solid #f8f3ec;
  box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(70,60,40,.25);
  font:600 36px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  transition:opacity .5s,transform .5s;
}
.seal small{
  position:absolute;
  bottom:10px;
  font:600 7px Montserrat,sans-serif;
  letter-spacing:2px;
}
.envelope.open .flap{transform:rotateX(180deg)}
.envelope.open .seal{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.7)}
.open-btn{
  margin-top:26px;
  padding:13px 24px;
  border:1px solid rgba(185,149,91,.55);
  border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);
  color:var(--blue-dark);
  letter-spacing:2px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  font-size:10px;
  transition:.3s;
}
.open-btn:hover{background:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px)}

.hidden{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}
main{opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.1s ease}
main.show{opacity:1}

.hero{
  min-height:100svh;
  position:relative;
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  text-align:center;
  color:white;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(42,48,47,.22),rgba(42,48,47,.48)),
    url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");
  background-size:cover;
  background-position:center;
}
.hero::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:22px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.58);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:40px 22px;max-width:850px}
.hero .eyebrow{
  font-size:22px;
  letter-spacing:5px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.hero h2{
  margin:22px 0 0;
  font:500 clamp(88px,18vw,190px)/.72 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  text-shadow:0 5px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
}
.hero .years{
  margin-top:26px;
  font:500 clamp(28px,6vw,54px) 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  letter-spacing:8px;
}
.hero .name{
  margin-top:8px;
  font:600 clamp(36px,7vw,64px) 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
}
.scroll-note{
  margin-top:36px;
  font-size:20px;
  letter-spacing:3px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  opacity:.9;
}

#sizefecha{
  font-size: 25px;
}

.section{
  padding:90px 20px;
  max-width:1100px;
  margin:auto;
}
.section.center{text-align:center}
.kicker{
  color:var(--gold);
  font-size:18px;
  letter-spacing:4px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.section h3{
  margin:12px 0 18px;
  font:600 clamp(42px,7vw,66px)/.95 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  color:var(--blue-dark);
}
.lead{
  max-width:720px;
  margin:auto;
  font:400 22px/1.55 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  color:#646363;
}

.timeline{
  margin-top:52px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:28px;
}
.event{
  position:relative;
  padding:42px 30px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.72);
  border:1px solid rgba(185,149,91,.28);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  text-align:center;
  border-radius:4px;
}
.event::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  top:14px;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:14px;
  border:1px solid rgba(185,149,91,.16);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.event-icon{
  width:58px;height:58px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  margin:0 auto 18px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:#edf3f4;
  color:var(--gold);
  font-size:25px;
}
.event h4{
  margin:0;
  font:600 35px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  color:var(--blue-dark);
}
.event .time{
  margin:8px 0 16px;
  font-size:12px;
  letter-spacing:3px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold);
}
.event p{line-height:1.7;font-size:14px;color:#666}
.map-btn{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:8px;
  margin-top:18px;
  padding:11px 17px;
  border:1px solid rgba(88,119,131,.35);
  color:var(--blue-dark);
  text-decoration:none;
  border-radius:999px;
  font-size:10px;
  letter-spacing:1.5px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  background:#fff;
  transition:.25s;
}
.map-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}

.countdown-wrap{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#edf3f4,#f9f5ee);
  border-top:1px solid rgba(185,149,91,.2);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(185,149,91,.2);
}
.countdown{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  gap:12px;
  max-width:850px;
  margin:42px auto 0;
}
.counter{
  padding:25px 10px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.65);
  border:1px solid rgba(185,149,91,.2);
}
.counter strong{
  display:block;
  font:600 clamp(42px,7vw,64px) 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  color:var(--blue-dark);
}
.counter span{
  font-size:9px;
  letter-spacing:2px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#777;
}

.gallery{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;
  gap:22px;
  margin-top:50px;
  align-items:stretch;
}
.photo-card{
  overflow:hidden;
  position:relative;
  min-height:500px;
  background:#ddd;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.photo-card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.photo-card.tall{min-height:680px}
.photo-stack{display:grid;gap:22px}
.photo-stack .photo-card{min-height:329px}
.photo-caption{
  position:absolute;
  left:18px;right:18px;bottom:18px;
  padding:15px 18px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.84);
  backdrop-filter:blur(7px);
  color:var(--blue-dark);
  font:500 22px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
}

.quote{
  min-height:520px;
  padding:90px 20px;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  text-align:center;
  background:
    linear-gradient(rgba(88,119,131,.82),rgba(88,119,131,.82)),
    url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");
  background-size:cover;
  background-position:center top;
  background-repeat:no-repeat;
  color:#fff;
}
.quote p{
  max-width:820px;
  margin:auto;
  font:500 clamp(34px,6vw,62px)/1.05 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
}
.quote small{
  display:block;
  margin-top:25px;
  font:400 10px Montserrat,sans-serif;
  letter-spacing:4px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  opacity:.9;
}

.music-section{text-align:center}
.music-box{
  max-width:700px;
  margin:35px auto 0;
  padding:30px;
  background:#fff;
  border:1px solid rgba(185,149,91,.24);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.music-title{
  font:600 34px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  color:var(--blue-dark);
}
.music-sub{font-size:12px;color:#777;line-height:1.6}
.music-button{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:10px;
  margin-top:15px;
  padding:14px 24px;
  border:0;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:var(--blue-dark);
  color:#fff;
  text-decoration:none;
  font-size:11px;
  letter-spacing:1.5px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.music-button:hover{opacity:.9;transform:translateY(-2px)}

.confirmation-section{
  padding:90px 20px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, rgba(215,163,161,.10), transparent 28%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 85% 80%, rgba(158,185,195,.14), transparent 30%),
    var(--cream);
  text-align:center;
}

.confirmation-card{
  width:min(900px,100%);
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:55px clamp(24px,5vw,70px);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);
  border:1px solid rgba(185,149,91,.28);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  position:relative;
}

.confirmation-card::before,
.confirmation-card::after{
  content:"✦";
  position:absolute;
  top:22px;
  color:var(--gold);
  font-size:18px;
  opacity:.8;
}

.confirmation-card::before{left:25px}
.confirmation-card::after{right:25px}

.confirmation-card h3{
  margin:12px 0 22px;
  font:600 clamp(34px,5vw,52px)/1 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  color:var(--blue-dark);
}

.confirmation-text{
  max-width:700px;
  margin:0 auto;
  font:400 20px/1.8 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  color:#5d6263;
}

.confirmation-text + .confirmation-text{
  margin-top:12px;
}

.confirmation-contacts{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:center;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:16px;
  margin-top:28px;
}

.confirmation-contact{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:9px;
  min-width:220px;
  justify-content:center;
  padding:13px 22px;
  border:1px solid rgba(88,119,131,.25);
  border-radius:999px;
  background:#fff;
  color:var(--blue-dark);
  text-decoration:none;
  font-size:20px;
  letter-spacing:.5px;
  transition:.3s ease;
}

.confirmation-contact:hover{
  transform:translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow:0 10px 25px rgba(63,71,72,.10);
}

.confirmation-thanks{
  margin:28px auto 0;
  max-width:700px;
  font:500 20px/1.7 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  color:var(--blue-dark);
}

.footer{
  padding:70px 20px;
  text-align:center;
  background:#f0e5d8;
}
.footer .big60{
  font:600 110px/.7 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  color:var(--gold);
}
.footer h5{
  margin:18px 0 8px;
  font:600 42px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  color:var(--blue-dark);
}
.footer p{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#777}

.float-heart{
  position:fixed;
  bottom:-30px;
  z-index:5;
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:.7;
  animation:rise linear forwards;
}
@keyframes rise{
  to{transform:translateY(-110vh) rotate(25deg);opacity:0}
}

@media(max-width:760px){
  .timeline,.gallery{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .photo-card.tall{min-height:570px}
  .photo-stack .photo-card{min-height:360px}
  .countdown{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .section{padding:70px 18px}
  .hero::after{inset:12px}
  .opening h1{font-size:58px}
  .envelope{transform:scale(.92)}
  .quote{
    min-height:460px;
    padding:75px 18px;
    background-position:center center;
  }
  .quote p{
    font-size:clamp(31px,8vw,48px);
  }
  .confirmation-section{
    padding:70px 18px;
  }
  .confirmation-card{
    padding:48px 20px;
  }
  .confirmation-contact{
    width:100%;
    min-width:0;
  }
}
</style>
</head>

<body>
<!-- Reproductor de musica: "Oh, Pretty Woman" - Roy Orbison (MP3 local, 1 min) -->
<audio id="bgMusic" loop preload="auto" style="display:none;">
  <source src="data:audio/mpeg;base64," type="audio/mpeg">
</audio>

<!-- Boton flotante de musica (respaldo si el navegador bloquea el autoplay) -->
<button id="musicToggle" type="button" aria-label="Activar musica" title="Musica"
  style="position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:9999;width:52px;height:52px;border:none;border-radius:50%;background:#0b6bcb;color:#fff;font-size:22px;line-height:52px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:transform .15s ease;">
  &#9835;
</button>

<script>
// ---- Reproductor de musica con audio local embebido (MP3 base64) ----
var bgAudio = document.getElementById("bgMusic");
var musicPlaying = false;

function updateBtn(){
  var b = document.getElementById("musicToggle");
  if (!b) return;
  b.innerHTML = musicPlaying ? "&#9835;" : "&#9834;";
  b.style.background = musicPlaying ? "#0b6bcb" : "#7a7a7a";
  b.title = musicPlaying ? "Pausar musica" : "Activar musica";
}

function tryPlay(){
  if (!bgAudio) return;
  try {
    bgAudio.volume = 0.75;
    var p = bgAudio.play();
    if (p && p.then) { p.catch(function(){ musicPlaying = false; updateBtn(); }); }
  } catch(err){}
}

if (bgAudio) {
  bgAudio.addEventListener("play",  function(){ musicPlaying = true;  updateBtn(); });
  bgAudio.addEventListener("pause", function(){ musicPlaying = false; updateBtn(); });
}

// Boton: alterna reproduccion (clic directo garantiza permiso de audio)
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
  var b = document.getElementById("musicToggle");
  if (!b) return;
  b.addEventListener("click", function(){
    if (!bgAudio) return;
    if (musicPlaying) { bgAudio.pause(); }
    else { tryPlay(); }
  });
});

// Interfaz "musica" usada por openInvitation()
var musica = {
  play: function(){
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject){
      if (!bgAudio) { resolve(); return; }
      bgAudio.volume = 0.75;
      var p = bgAudio.play();
      if (p && p.then) { p.then(resolve).catch(reject); } else { resolve(); }
    });
  },
  pause: function(){ if (bgAudio) bgAudio.pause(); }
};
</script>

<!-- SOBRE DE APERTURA -->
<section class="envelope-screen" id="envelopeScreen">
  <div class="opening">
    <div class="opening-kicker">Una celebración muy especial</div>

      </div>

    <button class="open-btn" id="openBtn">Abrir invitación</button>
  </div>
</section>

  <!-- EVENTOS -->

    </div>

    <div class="timeline">

      <article class="event">
        <div class="event-icon">✦</div>

        <p>
          <strong>Templo de Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe</strong><br>

        </p>

        </a>

      <article class="event">
        <div class="event-icon">♢</div>

        <div class="time">3:00 PM</div>
        <p>
          <strong>Quinta Los Arados</strong><br>
          Felipe Ángeles #46<br>
          Cd. Hidalgo, Michoacán
        </p>
        <a class="map-btn"
           href="https://maps.app.goo.gl/pJGAqoKU3htVY4Dh7?g_st=ic"
           target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
          📍 Ver ubicación
        </a>
      </article>

    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- FOTOS -->
  <section class="section">
    <div class="center">
      <div class="kicker">Momentos de una vida</div>
      <h3>Araceli</h3>
      <p class="lead">
        Una pequeña colección de recuerdos para celebrar a una mujer
        que ha llenado de momentos especiales la vida de quienes la rodean.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="gallery">
      <div class="photo-card tall">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Araceli en un jardín de rosas" loading="eager">
        <div class="photo-caption">Una vida llena de belleza y momentos para recordar.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="photo-stack">
        <div class="photo-card">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Araceli con vestido azul" loading="lazy">
          <div class="photo-caption">60 años y una sonrisa que sigue brillando.</div>
        </div>

        <div class="photo-card">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
          <div class="photo-caption">Celebrando a Araceli.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- FRASE -->
  <section class="quote">
    <p>
      “Que nunca falten motivos para sonreír,
      personas con quien compartir
      y sueños por cumplir.”
    </p>
    <small>Por un nuevo capítulo lleno de momentos inolvidables</small>
  </section>

  

  <!-- CIERRE -->
  <section class="section center">
    <div class="kicker">Gracias por acompañarnos</div>
    <h3>Nos encantará celebrar contigo</h3>
    <p class="lead">
      Tu presencia será el mejor regalo para Araceli
      en este día tan importante.
    </p>
  </section>

  <!-- CONFIRMACIÓN DE ASISTENCIA -->
  <section class="confirmation-section">
    <div class="confirmation-card">
      <div class="kicker">Confirmación de asistencia</div>
      <h3>Será un gusto contar con su presencia</h3>

      <p class="confirmation-text">
        Agradeceremos confirmar su asistencia a más tardar el día
        <strong>30 de octubre</strong>, indicando el número de personas que
        nos acompañarán, especificando adultos y niños.
      </p>

      <p class="confirmation-text">
        Para confirmar su asistencia, puede comunicarse vía telefónica o
        WhatsApp a cualquiera de los siguientes números:
      </p>

      <div class="confirmation-contacts">
        <a class="confirmation-contact" href="tel:+527861210188">
          📱 <span>786 121 0188</span>
        </a>
        <a class="confirmation-contact" href="tel:+524434951254">
          📱 <span>443 495 1254</span>
        </a>
      </div>

      <p class="confirmation-thanks">
        Agradecemos de antemano su confirmación y será un gusto contar con su
        presencia en esta celebración tan especial. 💙
      </p>
    </div>
  </section>

  <footer class="footer">
    <div class="big60">60</div>
    <h5>Araceli Saavedra Pimentel</h5>
    <p id="sizefecha">14 de noviembre de 2026 · Cd. Hidalgo, Michoacán</p>
  </footer>

</main>

<script>
const envelope = document.getElementById('envelope');
const openBtn = document.getElementById('openBtn');
const envelopeScreen = document.getElementById('envelopeScreen');
const main = document.getElementById('main');
let invitationOpened = false;

function openInvitation(){
  if (invitationOpened) return;
  invitationOpened = true;
  musica.play().catch(error => {
    console.log('El navegador bloqueó la reproducción automática:', error);
  });

  envelope.classList.add('open');

  setTimeout(() => {
    envelopeScreen.classList.add('hidden');
    main.classList.add('show');
    window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'smooth'});
    startHearts();
  }, 900);
}

envelope.addEventListener('click', openInvitation);
openBtn.addEventListener('click', openInvitation);

const eventDate = new Date('2026-11-14T13:00:00-06:00').getTime();

function updateCountdown(){
  const now = Date.now();
  let distance = eventDate - now;

  if(distance <= 0){
    document.getElementById('days').textContent = '0';
    document.getElementById('hours').textContent = '0';
    document.getElementById('minutes').textContent = '0';
    document.getElementById('seconds').textContent = '0';
    return;
  }

  const day = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24;
  const hour = 1000 * 60 * 60;
  const minute = 1000 * 60;

  const days = Math.floor(distance / day);
  distance %= day;
  const hours = Math.floor(distance / hour);
  distance %= hour;
  const minutes = Math.floor(distance / minute);
  const seconds = Math.floor((distance % minute) / 1000);

  document.getElementById('days').textContent = days;
  document.getElementById('hours').textContent = String(hours).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('minutes').textContent = String(minutes).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('seconds').textContent = String(seconds).padStart(2,'0');
}

updateCountdown();
setInterval(updateCountdown, 1000);
function startHearts(){
  setInterval(() => {
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'float-heart';
    el.textContent = Math.random() > .5 ? '✦' : '♡';
    el.style.left = (Math.random()*100) + 'vw';
    el.style.fontSize = (10 + Math.random()*12) + 'px';
    el.style.animationDuration = (6 + Math.random()*5) + 's';
    el.style.color = Math.random() > .5 ? '#b9955b' : '#d7a3a1';
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 12000);
  }, 1100);
}
</script>

</body>
</html>
